learning_outcomes.text: Analyse the operating characteristics of advanced gas turbine power plants.
Analyse the operating characteristics of advanced vapour power cycles.
Predict the behaviour of psychometric processes.
Analyse the compressible flow of gases and vapours.

syllabus_topics: Application of free power turbines with gas generators
Regenerative cycles with open and closed feed heaters
Combine heat and power vapour cycles with process steam bleed off
Use of Mollier chart for steam turbine expansion
Psychrometric processes and the psychrometric chart
Psychrometric plants such as air conditioning and climate control
1D Isentropic flows of gases and vapours
Stagnation properties and the use of isentropic flow tables
Normal shock waves and normal shock relationships and tables
Application to nozzles, diffusers and turbines
